messages.content: What is the current time in New York City?

function.name: weather_forecast_get
function.description: Retrieve the current weather forecast for a specific location. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The location you want to retrieve the weather for.

hour.description: The hour of the day in 24-hour format (optional). If not provided, the current hour will be used. Default: 24

message.content:
I don’t have access to real‑time clocks, so I can’t give you an exact “now” value.  
New York City operates on Eastern Time:

| Season | Standard Time | Daylight Saving |
|--------|---------------|----------------|
| Winter | EST – 5 h from UTC | — |
| Summer | EDT – 4 h from UTC | — |

If it’s currently between roughly March second Sunday and November first Sunday, subtract four hours from Coordinated Universal Time (UTC) to get NYC time. Outside those dates, subtract five hours instead.

For the precise current moment, check your phone, computer, or another reliable source set to the correct time zone.
message.reasoning:
User asks "current time" but we can't provide real-time info; maybe use timezone conversion or mention cannot fetch live data. We can approximate using UTC offset -5/UTC-4 depending DST. But better explain limitation and suggest checking local clock.

We should respond with explanation. No tool needed.
